description: This file contains the implementation of the LengthClass model class for the OpenCart admin module. It defines methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving length class data and descriptions, functioning as part of the backend data management for length measurement units within the e-commerce platform.

classes.name: LengthClass
classes.description: Model class for managing length measurement units and their descriptions within OpenCart's admin interface.

methods.name: addLengthClass
methods.description: Inserts a new length class into the database, adds descriptions for each language, clears related cache, and returns the new length class ID.

methods.name: editLengthClass
methods.description: Updates an existing length class and its descriptions, clears cache.

methods.name: deleteLengthClass
methods.description: Deletes a length class and its descriptions, clears cache.

methods.name: deleteLengthClassesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all length class descriptions associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getLengthClasses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of length classes with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getLengthClass
methods.description: Fetches data for a specific length class, including its descriptions.

methods.name: getTotalLengthClasses
methods.description: Returns the total count of length classes in the database.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Fetches all descriptions for a specific length class.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a length class for a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific length class.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions associated with a specific language across all length classes.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all length class descriptions for a given language.

methods.name: getDescriptionByUnit
methods.description: Fetches a length class description based on its unit string.
